stocks:GOOGL.standing: The parent company of Google, earning most of its revenue from search and YouTube advertising, alongside Google Cloud and Waymo. Its share is a running bet on whether AI assistants strengthen or erode the search ad business.
stocks:GOOGL.recent: Google's own benchmarks put Claude 9 points ahead of its Gemini 4 Argon, staff testing Gemini 4 Carbon likened its coding to Opus 5.5, and Google signed as buyer for 890 megawatts of new nuclear output. None of it accounts for the share price.

poly-saudi-houthi-ceasefire-agreement-an.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Houthis agree a ceasefire before the year ends. Its price is what traders pay for a yes, and it moves with strikes, mediation and the Red Sea shipping the war hangs over.
poly-saudi-houthi-ceasefire-agreement-an.recent: Houthi strikes shut Riyadh's airport, a drone hit near Shaybah and an attack in Dammam killed two, and none of it is a step toward a truce. The one talks track is Istanbul, where Pakistan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Turkey are bringing Britain, France and Germany in to mediate the Iran war, without Washington.

stocks:CRWV.standing: A US cloud company that rents Nvidia graphics processors to AI developers, financed largely with debt secured against those chips. Its share price shows how much borrowed money the AI build-out can still attract.
stocks:CRWV.recent: Lenders grew nervous about CoreWeave's borrowing, and by the end of the fortnight its troubles were being read as a threat to the whole AI junk market, the high-yield debt that pays for the data-centre build-out. If that market shuts, the company loses the funding its expansion runs on.

wiki-france.standing: How many people read Wikipedia's article on France each day. Its peaks mark the days events in the country reached people well beyond its borders.
wiki-france.recent: Marches backing pupils protesting run-down schools drew 161,500 people, then turned into nationwide riots: Limoges's town hall burned, police arrested nearly 2,400 people in one night, and partial curfews began at 11pm. Macron rejected his interior minister's resignation as France's 10-year bond yield reached 4.96%, the highest since 2002.

wiki-starlink.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on Starlink, SpaceX's network of thousands of low-orbit satellites selling broadband to homes, ships, aircraft and armies, Ukraine's front-line drone units among them.
wiki-starlink.recent: Musk accused Ambani of holding up Starlink's India launch, and Reliance answered that its own satellite service awaits clearance too. Days later Ukraine accused SpaceX of throttling terminals, so drone links cut out at speed on military missions. Trump now says access is restored, but Ukrainian sources see no change.

stocks:CNDT.standing: A US outsourcing firm spun off from Xerox in 2017 that runs back-office work for governments and companies: benefit payments, toll collection, health claims. Its shares move on state contracts and what they cost to run.

stocks:3690.HK.standing: China's largest platform for food delivery and local services, from restaurant orders to hotel bookings, listed in Hong Kong. Its margins swing on subsidy wars with rivals and on Beijing's rules for delivery couriers.
stocks:3690.HK.recent: In Brazil, Keeta found over half of the Rio chain outlets it targeted already tied to iFood by exclusive deals, and it is working around them. That arrived after this month's swings in the share, and nothing in the input explains them.

stocks:XYZ.standing: The company behind Square's card readers and software for small merchants and Cash App, a US peer-to-peer payments app. Its share moves with small-business and consumer spending, and it holds bitcoin on its balance sheet.

poly-will-aleksandar-vucic-united-serbia.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Aleksandar Vučić's Serbian Progressive Party wins the most seats in Serbia's 2026 parliamentary election. The party has led every government in Belgrade since 2012.

stocks:AIR.PA.standing: The European airliner maker that splits the world's large-jet market with Boeing, listed in Paris. Its jet deliveries drive the share; a defence and space arm builds military aircraft, satellites and rocket parts.
stocks:AIR.PA.recent: The fortnight brought Airbus shipping the first lighter engine bay for Ariane 6 Block 2, which saves less weight than first planned, and the first flight of its U740 Valkyrie drone at Mach 0.8. Neither accounts for the share price.

stocks:8473.T.standing: A Tokyo financial group that runs SBI Securities, Japan's largest online brokerage, alongside banking, asset management and crypto businesses. Its share follows Japanese retail trading volumes and the group's digital-asset bets.

stocks:055550.KS.standing: One of South Korea's largest financial groups, owner of Shinhan Bank, Shinhan Card and insurance and brokerage arms. Its share tracks Korean interest rates, household credit and the won.
stocks:055550.KS.recent: The one story in the input about Shinhan's own business was a plan, still at the looking stage, to let Japanese visitors pay in Korea with yen stablecoins. Nothing in it accounts for the fall in the share.

poly-will-a-us-iran-deal-in-2026-include.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether a US-Iran agreement reached in 2026 has Iran hand over its stockpile of enriched uranium, the material at the centre of the nuclear dispute and of any settlement between the two.
poly-will-a-us-iran-deal-in-2026-include.recent: Mediation crowded in: Lavrov offered to broker in Tehran, Iran set terms to reopen Hormuz within 6 days, and Munir carried proposals to Tehran. In the same days Iran's security chief said no enriched uranium will leave, ruling out the very handover this contract pays on, while seven foreign ministers meet in Istanbul on the Iran war.

wiki-china.standing: How many people read Wikipedia's article on China each day. The count rises when a trade dispute, a summit or a military move puts the world's second-largest economy in front of readers who want the basics.
wiki-china.recent: Nothing in the reporting explains the early-month peak. Since then the news from China has been a magnitude-7.0 earthquake near Baqen in Tibet that killed 16, a price war among its AI labs in which MiniMax undercut DeepSeek, and Beijing's bid for its own Antarctic marine reserve after years of blocking others.

poly-will-indiana-enact-a-data-center-mo.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Indiana enacts a pause on new data center construction before 2027. It is a bet on a state fight over the power and water that hyperscale campuses draw from local grids.

poly-will-chiang-wan-an-win-the-next-tai.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Chiang Wan-an, Taipei's Kuomintang mayor, wins the city's next mayoral election. Taipei's mayoralty has long been a springboard to Taiwan's presidency.

poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States invades Iran before 2027. Its price is what traders will stake on the step past strikes and blockade: American forces entering Iranian territory.
poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.recent: The Atlantic reports Trump is weighing several days of strikes right after the 3 November midterms on nuclear sites, missiles and energy infrastructure, and Mohsen Rezaei answered that Tehran could hit data centres and AI sites across the Gulf. Strikes from the air are not the invasion this contract pays on.

stocks:300750.SZ.standing: Contemporary Amperex Technology, the Ningde company listed in Shenzhen and the world's largest maker of electric-vehicle batteries. Carmakers from Tesla to BYD's rivals buy its cells, so its share tracks the EV and grid-storage build-out.

stocks:BARC.L.standing: Britain's second-largest bank by assets, combining a UK high-street bank and the Barclaycard business with one of the few European investment banks still competing on Wall Street. Its share price follows both UK rates and trading revenue.
stocks:BARC.L.recent: Barclays reported a quarter that missed estimates and paired it with a trade: 5,000 jobs cut, about 5% of staff, in a 'technology-enabled' cost drive built on AI, while shareholders get a buyback. It is one of the first big banks to name AI as the reason for cuts at this scale, and they fall on back-office and operations staff, many in India and the UK.

poly-will-deepseek-ipo-by-december-31-20.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if DeepSeek, the Hangzhou AI lab spun out of the hedge fund High-Flyer, lists its shares before 2028. A listing would open China's most closely watched AI lab to public shareholders.

poly-clarity-act-signed-into-law-in-2026.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the US Digital Asset Market Clarity Act becomes law in 2026. The bill would split oversight of crypto tokens between the SEC and the CFTC, settling which regulator the industry answers to.

wiki-anthropic.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on Anthropic, the San Francisco AI company behind the Claude models. It is one of a few labs building frontier systems, and its funding, revenue and safety policies shape how the industry is regulated.
wiki-anthropic.recent: An investor put Anthropic's third-quarter revenue at $16.8 billion as backers discussed a $1.5 trillion valuation, and a US regulator sent it and OpenAI more than 50 pages of questions. Days later it pledged 5% of its shares to a public fund and gave six outside auditors desks inside its office.

poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Democrats control the US Senate after the 2026 midterm elections. The Senate confirms judges and cabinet officers, so whoever holds it decides who a president can appoint.

stocks:LNG.standing: The largest exporter of liquefied natural gas in the United States, from terminals at Sabine Pass in Louisiana and Corpus Christi in Texas. It sells most of its output on long-term contracts to buyers in Europe and Asia.

stocks:VTRS.standing: A generic drugmaker formed in 2020 when Mylan merged with Pfizer's Upjohn unit. It sells off-patent brands such as Lipitor and Viagra, and supplies low-cost HIV medicines to public health systems worldwide.

stocks:7782.T.standing: The shares of Sincere Co., a Japanese company listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and priced in yen. The quote tracks what investors pay for one share of the company's own business.

poly-will-aleksandar-vucic-be-the-next-p.standing: A contract on whether Aleksandar Vučić, Serbia's president since 2017 and barred from a third term, returns to the prime minister's office he held before. It is a bet on where power in Belgrade sits once his presidency ends.

stocks:CMCSA.standing: America's largest cable operator, selling Xfinity broadband, TV and mobile, and the owner of NBCUniversal's studios, Peacock and theme parks. Its broadband subscriber count is the figure its shareholders watch most closely.
stocks:CMCSA.recent: Comcast lost 144,000 residential broadband customers in Q3, up from 91,000 a year earlier, as fiber and fixed-wireless rivals undercut its prices. It called those prices 'irrational' and answered with cable job cuts and more AI agents, cutting its own costs rather than matching them on price.

poly-bank-of-mexico-decreases-interest-r.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Banco de México cuts its overnight rate by a quarter point after November. That rate sets borrowing costs across Mexico and the yield gap that draws foreign money into the peso.
poly-bank-of-mexico-decreases-interest-r.recent: The fortnight's news carried the Fed, not Banxico: Warsh withheld guidance and called AI a shock to the economy, and economists told Reuters the Fed would skip October and raise rates again in December. None of it is about the Banxico decision these bets are on.

poly-venezuela-election-scheduled-by-dec.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Venezuela's authorities formally schedule a national election before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on a vote being called, not on one being held.

poly-trump-out-as-president-before-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Donald Trump stops being US president before 2027, whether by death, resignation or removal from office. Its price is what traders will pay to bet on an early end to his term.
poly-trump-out-as-president-before-2027.recent: The fortnight's news kept Trump at the centre of the Ukraine talks in Oslo, Witkoff's trip to Moscow and the weighing of Iran strikes after the midterms, but none of it bore on whether he leaves office early.

poly-us-iran-ceasefire-continues-through.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the ceasefire between the United States and Iran survives until the US midterm elections. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on strikes, threats and mediation.
poly-us-iran-ceasefire-continues-through.recent: Bets on the truce peaked after the White House ruled out a strike before the 3 November midterms, as Munir carried proposals to Tehran. Then The Atlantic reported Trump weighing strikes right after the vote, Mohsen Rezaei named Gulf data centres and AI sites in reply, and the Revolutionary Guard said 7 tankers were hit.

poly-will-marine-le-pen-win-the-2027-fre.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marine Le Pen, longtime leader of France's far-right National Rally, wins the 2027 presidential election. She reached the runoff in 2017 and 2022 and lost both times to Emmanuel Macron.

poly-will-anthropic-announce-bankruptcy-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI company that makes the Claude models, files for bankruptcy before 2028. It is a bet on whether the lab's heavy spending on compute outruns its funding.

poly-iran-full-airspace-closure-by-decem.standing: A Polymarket contract that settles yes if Iran closes all of its airspace before December 31. A full closure signals Tehran expects strikes, and forces airlines flying between Europe and Asia onto longer routes.
poly-iran-full-airspace-closure-by-decem.recent: The Atlantic reported Trump is weighing days of strikes on Iran's nuclear sites, missiles and energy infrastructure right after the 3 November midterms. Rezaei answered that Tehran could hit data centres, cables and AI sites in 7 Gulf states, as the Revolutionary Guard said 7 tankers were hit in Hormuz.

poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Federal Reserve raises its policy rate by a quarter point at its December 2026 meeting. That rate sets US borrowing costs and reaches mortgages, the dollar and emerging-market debt.
poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.recent: In Bangkok, Fed Chair Warsh called AI a shock to the economy and withheld guidance on rates. Nearly all economists polled now expect the Fed to skip October and hike in December. Oil prices driven by the Gulf war are feeding the sticky inflation behind that call, and the same higher-for-longer pressure is pushing gold down.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: South Korea's second-largest chipmaker and one of the world's two biggest makers of memory chips. It leads in high-bandwidth memory, the stacked DRAM beside AI accelerators, so its shares trade on AI data-centre spending.
stocks:000660.KS.recent: Doubts over AI spending and the rise of Chinese memory rivals hit Korean chipmakers, and in one session Samsung and SK Hynix dragged South Korea's benchmark down 5.5%. SK hynix then shelved a Solidigm listing worth up to $15 billion, keeping Intel's former NAND business in-house as AI data centres drive flash demand.

poly-will-jon-ossoff-win-the-2028-democr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jon Ossoff, the Democratic senator from Georgia, becomes his party's 2028 presidential nominee. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, not a forecast.

poly-will-google-have-the-best-ai-model-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Google holds the top spot on the LMArena chatbot leaderboard when October 2026 closes. Traders price each new model release from Google and its rivals into it within days of launch.

poly-france-declares-state-of-emergency-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether France declares an état d'urgence, the 1955 regime that lets the government ban gatherings and order searches and house arrests without a judge. It was invoked after the 2015 Paris attacks and in New Caledonia in 2024.

stocks:MRNA.standing: The Massachusetts biotech built on messenger RNA, the technology behind its Covid-19 vaccine. As Covid sales have shrunk, its value has come to rest on whether mRNA works against cancer and other diseases.
stocks:MRNA.recent: Phase 3 results for intismeran autogene, the personalised mRNA vaccine Moderna and Merck give alongside Keytruda, came out before their scheduled presentation: it cut melanoma relapse or death 42%. Each dose is built from the patient's own tumour mutations. The shares had climbed into the reveal, then slid as investors read the result as a disappointment.

wiki-unmanned-aerial-vehicle.standing: An aircraft flown with no pilot on board, either remotely or autonomously. Cheap long-range drones have become a main weapon of the Russia–Ukraine war and the Red Sea conflict, striking refineries, ships and cities far from any front.
wiki-unmanned-aerial-vehicle.recent: Drones partly disabled a second Yandex data centre in Kaluga, and a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport killed 3. Since then drones have sunk cargo ships off Bulgaria and Romania, where 1 sailor died when the Khoryv went down near Constanța, and Moscow's mayor counted 2,730 Ukrainian drones flying toward the city in a week.

stocks:MRK.standing: Shares of Merck & Co., the US drugmaker whose cancer immunotherapy Keytruda is among the world's best-selling medicines. That makes the stock a running verdict on how Merck replaces it in its oncology pipeline.
stocks:MRK.recent: Merck's own news was the melanoma vaccine it develops with Moderna. After an early success mid-month, full results showed the shot cut melanoma relapse or death by 42%. That readout came after the last close shown here, and Moderna's shares slid on the day, so nothing yet explains Merck's own move.

stocks:C.standing: One of the four largest US banks, and the most international of them, with operations in about 90 countries. Its shares trade on interest margins, credit losses and a multi-year overhaul ordered by US regulators.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the former Florida senator, wins the Republican nomination for the 2028 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, set against every rival in the field.

stocks:FM.TO.standing: A Vancouver-based copper miner listed in Toronto, producing mainly from the Kansanshi and Sentinel mines in Zambia. Its shares move with the copper price and with the fate of its Cobre Panamá mine in Panama.
stocks:FM.TO.recent: The one company-specific item in the fortnight was First Quantum preparing to seek state-backed tax breaks under Argentina's RIGI regime for Taca Taca, a $5.25 billion copper project. Nothing in it accounts for the fall in the share.

poly-putin-out-as-president-of-russia-by.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Vladimir Putin stops being Russia's president before the end of June 2027. He has led Russia as president or prime minister since 1999, and his succession has never been tested.
poly-putin-out-as-president-of-russia-by.recent: The fortnight put Putin at the centre of diplomacy: he met Trump's envoy Witkoff, proposed a summit with Trump and Xi that would seat no Ukrainian, and the Kremlin confirmed talks in Abu Dhabi in November. None of it touches his hold on office or accounts for the price.

stocks:INTC.standing: Intel designs PC and server processors and, unlike most chip companies, makes them in its own fabs. It is the US government's main bet on rebuilding leading-edge chip manufacturing at home.
stocks:INTC.recent: The one development about Intel's own business was regulatory. The FCC's loosely drawn ban on foreign-made robots forced it to seek a waiver for the automated guided vehicles that move wafers through its fabs, and it got one. That came at the end of the slide, and nothing reported explains the fall itself.

stocks:RHHBY.standing: Roche, the Basel drug and diagnostics group, priced in dollars. It is the world's largest maker of diagnostic tests, and its earnings rest on cancer medicines and the multiple sclerosis drug Ocrevus.

stocks:NVS.standing: Novartis, the Basel-based drugmaker, as its shares trade in New York. Its earnings rest on a few patented medicines, so trial readouts and patent expiries move it more than the economy does.
stocks:NVS.recent: Novartis's pill remibrutinib cut multiple sclerosis relapses 35.2% and 31.2% against teriflunomide in pivotal trials, results that landed after the chart's last close. It trails Roche's rival BTK inhibitor on efficacy but has a better safety profile, and in the first new MS drug class in years a liver-safety edge can decide which one patients get.

stocks:SNY.standing: The Nasdaq-listed American depositary shares of Sanofi, the Paris drugmaker. Its earnings lean heavily on Dupixent, an antibody for eczema and asthma, alongside one of the world's largest vaccine businesses.
stocks:SNY.recent: Sanofi settled an EU antitrust probe in mid-October, the only news about its own business in the fortnight. Nothing reported gives the terms of the settlement or ties it to the share price.

poly-will-any-country-join-the-mecca-agr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if any further country formally joins the Mecca Agreement before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on the pact widening beyond its founding signatories.

poly-sullivan-flips-peltola-for-alaska-s.standing: A Polymarket contract on Alaska's US Senate race, the seat Republican Dan Sullivan holds. It pays out if the outcome in its title happens by the deadline. Alaska counts ranked-choice ballots, so its results arrive late.

poly-will-the-republicans-win-the-texas-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if a Republican wins Texas's US Senate race in November 2026; its price is what traders pay for that outcome. Texas has not elected a Democrat statewide since 1994.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire before the end of 2026; its price is what traders pay for that outcome. It moves on envoys, summit dates and sanctions decisions.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.recent: Washington revived a negotiating track: Witkoff met Putin, Trump put on hold new Russia sanctions he signed into law, and the Kremlin confirmed Abu Dhabi talks with Ukraine for November. Putin wants a final settlement, not a "short" truce, and the only ceasefire announced, by Melania Trump, covers occupied Oleshky alone.
